title: LiveEdit: Towards Real-Time Diffusion-Based Streaming Video Editing
summary: Streaming video editing has made rapid progress, yet practical deployment is still limited by two core issues: maintaining stable backgrounds and non-edited regions over time, and achieving the low latency required for real-time interactive scenarios. Meanwhile, recent streaming video generation methods are mostly developed for synthesis and cannot be directly applied to editing due to the strict preservation requirement and region-specific control. In this work, we present a novel streaming vid…

platform_copies.reddit_body_en: A recent trend caught my eye: ReFreeKV: Towards Threshold-Free KV Cache Compression. Instead of reposting it as news, I'd frame it through Tencent Cloud scenario and focus on technical explainer. Would that make the discussion more useful for developers?

summary_cn: ReFreeKV: Towards Threshold-Free KV Cache Compression：为了减少 LLM 推理期间的内存消耗，人们提出了一些用于 KV 缓存修剪的方法。虽然这些技术可以在许多数据集上实现无损内存减少，但它们通常取决于一个被低估的条件：需要预先确定 KV 缓存预算的输入/域特定阈值才能实现最佳性能。
